about: Renovating a 51–78 m² apartment in the centre

Mid-size apartments in the centre are a popular format both for yourself and for letting. At 51–60 m² people usually choose a kitchen-living room and a separate bedroom with a wardrobe; at 70–78 m² — two bedrooms and a second bathroom. We make the final decision after measurements and several layout options.

The city centre means street noise, so we recommend quality windows, sealed reveals and sound insulation of bedroom walls. For letting — hard-wearing flooring, washable paints and easy-care furniture.
A renovation in a business-class building is usually agreed with the management company: work schedule, lift use, waste removal. We take this part on.
For reference: developer — Alliance Novobud, address — Velyka Vasylkivska St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in Montreal House cost?

Turnkey renovation starts from $550/m² (labour and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are extra, per the estimate), a design project from $30/m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250/m². The calculation for a 65 m² apartment is in the budget guide above; we fix the exact amount in the estimate after the inspection.
How can street noise be reduced?
We check the windows and reveals, reinforce the sound insulation of the bedroom walls if needed and choose heavy curtains. The solutions are built into the project.
Do you renovate apartments in the centre for letting?
Yes, with practical materials and complete fit-out: furniture, appliances and textiles before the tenant moves in.
We hand over the apartment with a signed acceptance certificate; all completed works carry a 12-month warranty.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send photo reports from the site via Telegram, and the price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract.
